# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She speaks with a sweet voice and dresses beautifully, wearing noticeably large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is sympathetic, bright, tactful, and broadminded, possessing a natural gift for winning her students' affection and encouraging their best abilities. She is dedicated and deeply attached to her pupils, choosing to remain teaching them over accepting other positions. Her guidance inspires self-reliance, thoughtful exploration, and honest self-criticism in her students.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

- Bring out the best mentally and morally in her pupils  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Prepare her advanced pupils to pass the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P18](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0018)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the trustees as the first female teacher at Avonlea school. She introduced novel educational practices, including morning and evening physical culture exercises, nature study field afternoons, composition practice, and biweekly recitation afternoons. In late autumn, she organized a Christmas Night school concert to fund a schoolhouse flag. She later formed an advanced class to prepare willing students for the entrance examination to Queen's Academy, giving them an extra hour of instruction after school. Though offered a job in her home district, she chose to stay in Avonlea for a second year to see her students through their Entrance exams. After successfully guiding all her Queen's class candidates through the examination in Charlottetown, her rule at Avonlea school came to an end at the close of June. She was later invited to dinner at Green Gables alongside the Allans during a visit back to Avonlea.
